task: Making stuffed mini sweet peppers with herbed cheese
query: How do I make stuffed mini sweet peppers with herbed cheese?

goal.title: Prepare creamy stuffed mini peppers
goal.description: Wash and dry four small bell peppers, trim their tops and scrape out the interiors. Mix chopped herbs and pinched seasonings into a prepared creamy filling, spoon it into all four peppers and arrange them on a plate.
goal.final_state: Four uncooked peppers with creamy filling visible at their open ends lie arranged on a plate. No heating or tasting is shown.

procedure.description: Gather four small bell peppers from the cutting board, carry them to the sink, turn on the faucet and spread a towel beside the basin. Rotate and rub each pepper individually under running water, putting the washed peppers on the towel. Turn the faucet off after washing the fourth.
Fold the towel over the peppers and rub and roll them inside it. Uncover them, gather all four, carry them back to the kitchen counter and lay them on the cutting board.

Move the empty scrap bowl beside the board and take the knife. Hold each pepper in turn and cut across its stem end, placing the detached top into the scrap bowl. Set the knife down after cutting the fourth pepper.
Leave the counter and look over the dining table for several seconds, without visible food preparation, then return to the peppers.

Take a small metal spoon. Hold each trimmed pepper over the scrap bowl and repeatedly scrape its inside while turning it in the left hand. Drop the loosened seeds and inner material into the bowl and return each hollow pepper to the board.

Put down the scraping utensil and pick chopped green herbs from the board in several pinches, dropping them into the already prepared creamy filling. Stir with the spoon while holding the bowl. Add pinches from each of the two small white bowls, then stir again. The exact identities of the creamy base and these seasonings are not established visually.
Pause to tap the phone lying on the stove. Return to the counter, hold the filling bowl and stir and scrape the mixture with the spoon, then reach for the first hollow pepper.

Hold the first pepper in the left hand and repeatedly spoon creamy filling into its open end, pressing and leveling it with the spoon; place it on the plate. Fill the red pepper and return it to the board, then fill the two remaining yellow peppers one at a time, putting one on the board and retaining the last in the left hand.

Move the filled peppers from the board to the plate, first handling the yellow peppers and then the red pepper. Pause to tap the phone again, then retrieve the final yellow pepper and arrange all four stuffed peppers on the plate. Withdraw both hands and look at the finished plate until the clip ends. No baking or eating is shown.

coarse.instruction: Wash and dry the bell peppers
coarse.description: Carry four peppers to the sink, turn on the faucet and rinse them individually, placing each on the towel. Shut off the water, rub the peppers in the folded towel, uncover them and carry them back to the cutting board.
coarse.goal_contribution: Provides washed, dried peppers for trimming and hollowing.

coarse.instruction: Trim and hollow the four peppers
coarse.description: Position a scrap bowl beside the board, cut off all four pepper tops with the knife and discard the tops. After a walk away from the kitchen, return and scrape each pepper interior with the spoon, dropping seeds and loose material into the scrap bowl.
coarse.goal_contribution: Creates open hollow peppers that can hold the creamy filling.
coarse.predictability_reason: After wash and dry the bell peppers, trim and hollow the four peppers is a natural next stage toward prepare creamy stuffed mini peppers.

coarse.instruction: Season and mix the creamy filling
coarse.description: Pick chopped herbs from the board and drop them into the prepared creamy base, stir, add pinches from both small seasoning bowls and stir again. Pause to operate the phone, then return and mix and scrape the filling thoroughly.
coarse.goal_contribution: Distributes the visible herbs and seasonings through the filling before the peppers are stuffed.
coarse.predictability_reason: After trim and hollow the four peppers, season and mix the creamy filling is a natural next stage toward prepare creamy stuffed mini peppers.

coarse.description: Spoon the creamy mixture into each hollow pepper in repeated scoops, press and level the openings, and set the filled peppers on the board or plate. Transfer the remaining filled peppers to the plate, with a brief phone interruption, and arrange all four.
coarse.goal_contribution: Completes the stuffed pepper snack and leaves all four portions together on a plate.
coarse.predictability_reason: After season and mix the creamy filling, fill and plate the peppers is a natural next stage toward prepare creamy stuffed mini peppers.
